  Question 1/1 (1 unanswered)
  When sending a large fixture payload through a helper process while the receiver is temporarily unavailable and the terminal is narrow, which transport should preserve delivery ordering, retries,
  and a clear progress indication for the person waiting at the laptop?

  › 1. HTTP helper (Recommended)  Send a complete request through a helper process, retain the payload until the receiver confirms delivery, and show progress while retrying temporary failures
                                  without duplicating accepted messages.
    2. WebSocket stream           Stream smaller chunks over a persistent connection, reconnect when needed, preserve chunk ordering across retries, and display partial progress even when the
                                  receiver takes a long time to recover.
    3. None of the above          Optionally, add details in notes (tab)
